parameters.emailMessage/Subject:
@{concat(
  'TID',
  substring(
    concat('00000', string(outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/ID'])),
    sub(length(concat('00000', string(outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/ID']))), 5),
    5
  )
)} @{outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/task_name']} Has Been Revised and now Requires Your Approval
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hi @{outputs('Update_item_-_Approval_List')?['body/ID_User_Approver/Value']},

A task has been Revised and is awaiting your review:
Task ID : @{concat( 'TID', substring( concat('00000', string(outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/ID'])), sub(length(concat('00000', string(outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/ID']))), 5), 5 ) )}
Task Name : @{outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/task_name']}
Task Priority : @{outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/ID_Priority/Value']}
Task Description : @{outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/task_description']}
Plan Start Date : @{formatDateTime( outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/plan_start_date'], 'dddd, dd MMM yyyy' )}
Actual Start Date : @{formatDateTime( outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/actual_start_date'], 'dddd, dd MMM yyyy' )}
Plan Finish Date : @{formatDateTime( outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/plan_finish_date'], 'dddd, dd MMM yyyy' )}
Actual Finish Date : @{formatDateTime( outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/actual_finish_date'], 'dddd, dd MMM yyyy' )}
Submitted By : @{outputs('Update_item_-_Task_List')?['body/ID_User_Task_Finished_By/Value']}
Note By Requestor : @{if( equals(items('For_each')?['note_by_requestor'], null), '-', items('For_each')?['note_by_requestor'] )}

Please review and take the necessary action through the link below:
Open Power Apps

Thank you.
